content_blocks.text: Jeremy O'Connor, Books & Manuscripts is committed to making this website accessible to all visitors, including those with disabilities. We aim to follow the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) as a general standard, and to keep improving as the site evolves.

content_blocks.heading: Feedback
content_blocks.text: If you encounter any barrier to accessing content on this site, please let us know at jeremy@jorarebooks.com. We'll do our best to address it promptly.
